sources.evidence: EN 1991-1-1:2002 table 6.2: category A balconies qk 2.5–4.0 kN/m² and Qk 2.0–3.0 kN. National annex may set values. Concentrated local verification is a separate case.
Terrace glulam table: L/300, reliability class 1, service class 2, imposed load 4.0 kN/m²; third support assumes continuity. These conditions are not copied as a generic outdoor C24 profile.

Manufacturer terrace table assumes design snow load 4.5 kN/m², not characteristic snow load. C24 48x198 at c/c600: indicative 3.1 m. Board thickness 21/28/34 mm requires c/c400/600/800 mm respectively.
First generation Eurocodes remain applicable during transition; national annexes with nationally determined parameters must be used.

notes: The EN table was visually read from original PDF. No UK or Swedish NA values are presented as Norwegian values.
